Package org.osgi.impl.service.useradmin

Class UserAdminImpl

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.impl.service.useradmin.UserAdminImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserAdmin
public class UserAdminImpl extends Object implements UserAdmin
UserAdminimplementation. All modifications of the database are synchronized using a lock object.

  • Field Details

    • rolemap

      protected Hashtable<String,RoleImpl> rolemap
      The role database. It is represented as a mapping from role names to roles.

    • version

      protected long version
      Database version number. Increases every time the database is modified. Used to check if an authorization cache should be invalidated.

    • adminPermission

      protected UserAdminPermission adminPermission
      An instance of UserAdminPermin.ADMIN.

    • ANYONE

      protected static final String ANYONE
      The name of the always present role. This role is always implied.

    • alive

      protected boolean[] alive
      Flag telling if this UserAdmin is active or not. Used by Authorization objects to check if the UserAdmin that created them is still active. The state must be a mutable object, hence the placement as an array element.
